solution_folio3_employee_self_service_ap.section: An Employee Self-Service Layer Built Into Your Microsoft Cloud
paragraphs: Folio ESS runs on the same Microsoft cloud your business systems already sit on. Hosted on Azure. Identity from Azure Active Directory. Data in Dataverse. Extensibility through Power Platform. Deployed and supported by a Microsoft Solutions Partner.
Nothing about the app is bolted on. Every capability it needs comes from a Microsoft service you already own, wrapped in a user experience purpose-built for employee self-service.
